headline.purpose: welcome question (36px from 640px) and liquidation title.

title.purpose: panel headings and status badges. The product name in the header is slightly larger (700, 20px).

body.purpose: text and table values. Long text is capped at 65ch.

label.purpose: buttons, field labels, row headers, totals.

small.purpose: gauge graduations, chart caption, dollar values under quantities. Marks and caption warnings use 600.

motion.name: flood
motion.purpose: The liquidation report rises from below (clip-path). Off when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Barlow, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); background: var(--color-river); color: #fff; padding: 12px 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-river-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-water); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Header Button

components.name: Action Switch
components.css: .ds-switch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-stone); } .ds-switch button { font-family: Barlow, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-switch button:hover { background: var(--color-stone-dark); } .ds-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-river); color: #fff; } .ds-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-water); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Amount Field
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Barlow, Helvetica, sans-serif; display: block; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font: inherit; color: inherit; background: #fff; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-soft); border-radius: 6px; caret-color: var(--color-water); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-soft); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-water); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Health from the API: a word first, then a color.
components.html: No debtSafeUnsafeWarningLiquidatable
components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: var(--color-river); } .ds-badge { font-family: Barlow, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; padding: 2px 10px; border: 2px solid; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-badge-nodebt { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-mist) 60%, transparent); } .ds-badge-safe { border-color: var(--color-mist); } .ds-badge-unsafe { border-color: var(--color-amber); color: var(--color-amber); } .ds-badge-warning { border-color: var(--color-amber); background: var(--color-amber); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-badge-liquidatable { border-color: #fff; background: var(--color-limit); }

components.css: .ds-gauge { font-family: Barlow, Helvetica, sans-serif; display: flex; background: var(--color-river); color: #fff; padding: 28px 0 16px 28px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-gauge-staff { position: relative; width: 112px; height: 288px; flex-shrink: 0; box-sizing: border-box; border-right: 2px solid var(--color-mist); font-size: 14px; } .ds-gauge-tick { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; line-height: 1; transform: translateY(50%); color: var(--color-mist); } .ds-gauge-mark { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-gauge-tick i { width: 10px; border-top: 2px solid var(--color-mist); } .ds-gauge-water { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 288px; } .ds-gauge-water svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-gauge-fill { fill: var(--color-water); } .ds-gauge-line { fill: none; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-gauge-75, .ds-gauge-90, .ds-gauge-100 { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; transform: translateY(50%); outline: 2px solid var(--color-river-deep); } .ds-gauge-75 { bottom: 68.18%; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-mist); } .ds-gauge-90 { bottom: 81.82%; border-top: 2px solid var(--color-amber); } .ds-gauge-100 { bottom: 90.91%; border-top: 4px solid var(--color-limit-light); }

narrative.overview:
A flood gauge beside a river. Debt is the water, borrowing power is the graduated staff, and 100% is the mark it must not pass. One dark river panel carries the level; everything else is quiet, pale and flat around it.

Tokens live in the `@theme` block of `app/globals.css`. Values without a token (type sizes, radii, spacing) are Tailwind 4 defaults.
keyCharacteristics: Dark river panel on pale stone ground
One family, Barlow, in three weights, with tabular figures
Red means the limit, and nothing else
Every color state is also written in words

rules.name: The Reserved Red Rule
rules.body: Both reds belong to the 100% mark and to liquidation. A form error, a lost account or a stale price is amber.

rules.name: The Word First Rule
rules.body: Color never carries a state alone: each badge shows its name, and each gauge mark is labelled.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular on the whole page, so a price tick never shifts the layout.

dos: Do use the tokens of `@theme` for every color.
Do write the state in words next to its color.
Do say when a value is observed, stale, frozen or zoomed.
Do keep one display-size figure: the utilization.
donts: Don't use either red outside the 100% mark and liquidation.
Don't add shadows: use the tonal steps.
Don't smooth the water between two observations.
